name: Look up a member and read their savings balance
description: Sign on to the Corebank servicing console, search for a member by ID, and read the member's name and current savings balance from the account summary.
goal: Sign on with the provided operator credentials, search for member {member_id}, and read that member's name and current savings balance.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: The member number to look up.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: Current savings balance, normalised to integer cents.

success.description: The savings balance pane rendered for a valid member.
